_comment: Single source of truth for the per-agent hook configs. Generated files: .claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json, .devin/hooks.v1.json. Edit the command strings here in clean repo-relative form, then run python3 scripts/gen_agent_hooks.py to regenerate. The generator injects a working-directory-independence wrapper (cd to git toplevel) into every repo-script command so hooks run regardless of the session's CWD. Do NOT edit the generated files directly; .pre-commit-config.yaml enforces this with gen_agent_hooks.py --check. See docs/standards/agent-hooks-generation.md.
_installer_scope_audit_comment: Audit of every SessionStart provisioning installer's per-agent scope (Refs #1606; wired in #1608). The generator (gen_agent_hooks.py) reads only 'targets'; this sibling key is ignored at render time, so it documents intent without altering any generated config and does not affect --check. Operator decision (#1606): every web installer reproduces a devcontainer capability that the nix path skips, and codex/devin web sessions equally lack that nix path, so ALL installers are classified 'shared' for uniform cross-agent parity -- including ccusage, whose Claude-scoped telemetry has no data source under codex/devin and is therefore an accepted no-op there. The analytical signal 'does a pre-commit/local gate invoke the binary directly' (true for uv, bun, actionlint; false for the explicit-use binaries rtk/apm/waza/ccusage/zizmor/lychee/betterleaks) is retained per entry to show which installers are already functionally required versus provisioned for uniformity. The 'wired' field records the CURRENT wiring -- now all three agents for every installer. #1608 performed the wiring AND the remote-gate widening it needs: each script previously gated on CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE only, so config wiring alone was a no-op under codex's CODEX_CODE_REMOTE signal; every installer now gates on both signals (mirroring install-uv.sh) and persists PATH via scripts/_session_path.sh. See docs/standards/agent-hooks-generation.md.

scripts/install-uv.sh.rationale: Python runtime foundation: every agent runs python3/uv-run SessionStart and PreToolUse hooks. Genuinely operative in every agent -- gates on both CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE and CODEX_CODE_REMOTE and is the gate-widening reference for #1608.

scripts/session_uv_local_pin.sh.rationale: Aligns the local-host uv with the repo pin so any agent's process PATH resolves the pinned uv; agent-agnostic and genuinely operative -- gates on both remote signals.

scripts/install-bun.sh.rationale: Backs the agent-agnostic Mermaid pre-commit gate (scan-mermaid-syntax soft-skips when bun/node_modules absent); any agent editing docs trips it. Wired into codex+devin in #1603; remote gate widened to CODEX_CODE_REMOTE in #1608 so it is operative there.

scripts/install-actionlint.sh.rationale: Backs the agent-agnostic workflow-lint pre-commit gate (id: actionlint soft-skips when the binary is absent); structurally identical to install-bun.sh (soft-skip pre-commit + nix CI hard gate). Wired into codex+devin and gate widened to CODEX_CODE_REMOTE in #1608.

scripts/install-rtk.sh.rationale: Explicit `rtk <cmd>` affordance (no pre-commit gate invokes it; its `rtk hook claude` hook is Claude-named and unshipped). Shared for uniform cross-agent provisioning of devcontainer-parity tools; wired into codex+devin and gate widened to CODEX_CODE_REMOTE in #1608.

scripts/install-apm.sh.rationale: Explicit `apm <cmd>` affordance (no in-session gate depends on it; compilation runs via CI / local `apm compile`). Shared for uniform cross-agent provisioning of devcontainer-parity tools; wired into codex+devin and gate widened to CODEX_CODE_REMOTE in #1608.

scripts/install-waza.sh.rationale: Explicit `waza <cmd>` affordance (the skill-quality pre-commit gate uses the separate scripts/install_waza.sh, not this SessionStart installer). Shared for uniform cross-agent provisioning of devcontainer-parity tools; wired into codex+devin and gate widened to CODEX_CODE_REMOTE in #1608.

scripts/install-ccusage.sh.rationale: ccusage reads Claude Code's local usage-telemetry JSONL; the metric it feeds (session_resource_report/cache-regime) is Claude-scoped. Shared per operator decision (#1606) for uniform provisioning; it is an ACCEPTED no-op under codex/devin where no telemetry data source exists. Wired into codex+devin and gate widened to CODEX_CODE_REMOTE in #1608.

scripts/install-zizmor.sh.rationale: Explicit-use binary for an effectiveness-measurement phase; the deterministic gate is the pure-python scan_workflow_injection.py (needs no binary). Shared for uniform cross-agent provisioning of devcontainer-parity tools; wired into codex+devin and gate widened to CODEX_CODE_REMOTE in #1608.

scripts/install-lychee.sh.rationale: Explicit-use binary for an effectiveness-measurement phase; the deterministic gate is the pure-python scan_markdown_links.py (needs no binary). Shared for uniform cross-agent provisioning of devcontainer-parity tools; wired into codex+devin and gate widened to CODEX_CODE_REMOTE in #1608.

scripts/install-betterleaks.sh.rationale: Explicit-use binary for an effectiveness-measurement phase; the deterministic gate is the pure-python scan_secrets.py (needs no binary). Shared for uniform cross-agent provisioning of devcontainer-parity tools; wired into codex+devin and gate widened to CODEX_CODE_REMOTE in #1608.

scripts/install-prek.sh.rationale: Provisions the prek (j178/prek) git-hook runner that .githooks/pre-commit execs (core.hooksPath=.githooks; ADR-0001). Without it the first commit in a fresh remote clone is blocked, so it is genuinely operative on every agent that commits. Runs SYNCHRONOUSLY (no async) so commit readiness is gated on the install completing, not raced by a background hook (Codex review on #2098). Gates on both CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE and CODEX_CODE_REMOTE; unlike the release-binary installers it installs via 'uv tool install prek' (no curl/sha path). Refs #2098.

permissions._comment: Platform-neutral permission intents (RFC #2022 A-2). gen_agent_hooks.py compiles each intent's 'claude' rule strings into the .claude/settings.json permissions block; gen_agent_hooks.py --check verifies every 'realized_by' hook is wired in .codex/hooks.json and .devin/hooks.v1.json. Codex/Devin have no committed native permission file (Codex permission scope lives in an uncommitted config.toml and Codex hooks reject allow/ask), so deny intents are realized by the equivalent gate hook and Claude-only UX is declared with 'claude_only'. Do NOT hand-edit the generated permissions block. See docs/standards/agent-hooks-generation.md.

allow.rationale: Claude no-prompt UX for plan files under /tmp/claude-plans. Codex hooks reject allow decisions and this repo commits no .codex/config.toml, so no portable codex/devin target exists.
